title = Infantry II: Light Machine Gunner
20mhit = 20 m target hit! 50mhit = 50 m target hit! 100mhit = 100 m target hit! Good shooting. 200mhit = 200 m target hit! Well done! 500mhit = 500 m target hit! Excellent! gunrange = Firing Line bunker = Sandbag Pit vehiclerange = Vehicle Target Range
1.0.label = The Light Machinegun
1.1.label = Intro 1.1.alert.modal = The light machinegun ("LMG") is a very powerful weapon when used correctly. It is best used as suppression fire at medium to long range and becomes much more useful when accompanied by riflemen who can provide additional ammunition and protection from enemy on the flanks.
1.2.label = Firing Position 1.2.alert = Move forward to the firing line. #waypoint label: "Firing Line" #waypoint: -314046.54,3603720.08,101.73
1.3.label = Undeployed Firing 1.3.alert = The LMG can be fired from the hip (or "undeployed"), but this is impossible to aim well due to its recoil and weight.[NL][NL]Press {fpfire} to fire the weapon. 1.3.complete.modal = Obviously, the LMG should only be used as a last resort against close enemies.
1.4.label = Go Prone 1.4.alert = The LMG should be fired from a deployed position. You can deploy the weapon when prone or when crouched next to objects such as short walls, crates, and window sills.[NL][NL]Press {fpprone} to go prone.
1.5.label = Deploy 1.5.alert = Press {fpdeploy} to deploy the LMG's bipod.[NL][NL]For this tutorial, you MUST use {fpdeploy} to deploy the weapon.[NL]However, in other circumstances, you can use the right mouse button to deploy.
1.6.label = Deployed Fire 1.6.alert = Now aim and fire the weapon at the a target by pressing {fpfire}.[NL][NL]Reload the weapon with {fpreload} if you are low on ammo.[NL][NL]Hit any target to continue. 1.6.complete.modal = Good! Firing from a deployed position is much more accurate than firing while undeployed.
1.7.label = Gunsight Range 1.7.alert.modal = Just like rifles, LMGs have adjustable sights for firing at different distances. The default range setting is 200 meters. 1.7.alert.hilite = primary,target 1.7.alert1.modal = Take a moment to fire different targets with different range settings to see how it affects your accuracy.[NL][NL]Use {gunsightrangeinc} and {gunsightrangedec} to increase and decrease your range setting. 1.7.alert1.hilite = primary,target
1.8.label = Undeploy 1.8.alert = When you are done firing, press {fpdeploy} to undeploy your machine gun. 1.8.complete.modal = Good. Stand up by pressing {fpprone}.
2.0.label = Vehicle Targets
2.1.label = Damaging Vehicle 2.1.alert = While the LMG is a devastating weapon against enemy infantry, it can also be effective against vehicles with little to no armor, such as trucks and haulers.[NL][NL]Move to the Vehicle Target Range. #waypoint label "Vehicle Target Range" #waypoint: -313992.15,3603761.89,100.82
2.2.label = Firing Position 2.2.alert = This is the Vehicle Target Range.[NL][NL]Enter the sandbag training pit. #waypoint label: "Sandbag Pit" #waypoint: -313969.40,3603763.17,100.32
2.3.label = Deploy on Sandbags 2.3.alert = Press {fpdeploy} to deploy the LMG's bipod on the sandbag wall.[NL][NL] Get as close as possible to the wall if you are unable to deploy. 2.3.complete = Excellent!
2.4.label = Firing Arc 2.4.alert.modal = Move the gun left and right to see the firing arc, which is different than when deployed on the ground.[NL]Deploying the LMG against an object usually improves its firing arc significantly. 2.4.alert.modal = Now fire at the closest vehicle hulk. 2.4.complete.modal = Excellent. This completes your introduction to the light machinegun.
content.brief: Learn how to operate a light machine gun.
